notes: Notifications, the terminal, the login screen and the app drawer now share the Soarix look, and Appearance keeps them in step with your theme
The app drawer has a Favorites row at the top; pin the apps you use most
Settings: a new Workspaces card chooses a fixed number of workspaces or lets them grow as needed
Add-ons can now be installed on an installed computer (they could not be unpacked before), and /usr/local is writable for your own programs
Server: the NovaCPX hosting panel is available as an add-on (with a license that includes it)
Server: PHP 7.4, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4 side by side, plus sqlite3, DKIM key tools and a web terminal
Server: security auditing is on, so SELinux problems can be diagnosed
Soarix's own windows open faster: each one now loads only what it needs
The Light theme now also changes Soarix's own windows (Update, Appearance, Network and the rest)
Appearance: Reset in the menu now also puts windows back side by side
Under the hood: every edition is now built from one list of files and apps, so a fresh install and an update always match
The system log is now kept on disk from the very first start, so a problem on the first boot can still be read afterwards
The server's default web page now says Soarix (it showed another system's name before)
First start of the desktop or server edition now shows what it is doing on screen, and sets the clock first so the download is not delayed
The installer now sets the computer's clock correctly at the end of an install (arrives with the next installer ISO)
The installer can now install the Server edition: pick "Install Soarix as a server" in the boot menu (your license must include it)
Version number shown in the installer boot menu
Windows option in Appearance: tiled or floating (overlapping) windows, Super+V floats one window
Add-ons manager (Apps and Add-ons) for private software such as NovaCPX; the Store still handles public apps
All GTK 3 apps now use the Soarix colors too (Print Settings, Network Connections and more)
Edition and Upgrade your license moved from System Information to Soarix Update
Network toolkit and Network window in every edition
Security: Wi-Fi passwords and license keys are no longer visible in the list of running programs
Fixes: the clock window no longer keeps a timer running after it closes; faster window floating
Every GTK app (Files, Characters, Clocks, Disks, Document Viewer, Bluetooth and more) now uses the Soarix colors
New windows: Appearance, Display Settings, Network, Network Devices, Printers and Users in the Soarix style
Administrator password setting: ask once after a restart (System Information)
Network toolkit installed (ping, traceroute, nmap, dig, speed test and more)
New System Information window: hardware, edition, switch between command line, desktop and server, upgrade your license key
New Date & Time window: time zone, 12-hour or 24-hour (military) time, automatic time, manual date and time
American spelling throughout the Soarix text
Soarix Update, License and Essentials are now graphical windows in the Soarix style
Pop-up menus (settings lists, power menu) now use the Soarix colors
Version numbers now work: this is Soarix 0.2.0 (shown at the login screen, in About and by soarix-update status)
New Appearance app: wallpaper (five to choose from), light or dark theme, accent color
Display Settings: lock screen with a clock, automatic lock, and a screen saver that turns the screen off
Launchers fixed: Soarix Update (now a menu), Soarix License and Soarix Essentials open properly
The screen starts at 1080p in virtual machines; SoarixOS wallpaper by default
Installer: no more freeze at the end, computer name and Wi-Fi setup, cleaner finish
